instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-shot setup: claim the WLEZ vault PDA and create the WLEZ token definition via a chained token::NewFungibleDefinition.
Idempotent - re-running is a no-op (vault already claimed, definition already owned by the token program).

instructions.name: wrap
docs: Lock `amount` native LEZ into the vault and mint `amount` WLEZ to the user's holding.
The native leg is a chained authenticated_transfer::Transfer, dispatched to the native program id recorded in the vault's data at Initialize.
The mint authority is supplied by this program via with_pda_seeds(wlez_definition_seed) on the chained token::Mint.

instructions.name: unwrap
docs: Burn `amount` WLEZ from the user's holding and release `amount` native LEZ from the vault.

The burn is authorised by the user's signature on user_holding; the native release is performed by WLEZ mutating the vault and user_native balances directly in its own post-states (it is both the executing program and the vault owner), so there is no chained native transfer.

types.name: VaultData
docs: The vault's `data` holds the canonical native (authenticated-transfer) program id as 32 little-endian bytes, written once at Initialize and read back by every Wrap to pin the native-transfer leg.
